title: Building Estimator / Draftsperson - Awnings, Decks & Light Structural Works
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a Building Estimator?
Do you have Construction Trade experience?
mandatory_unmet: 'At least two years' hands-on experience in both estimating and drafting awnings and decks, or closely related light structural works' is stated as a requirement; Marc has no matching commercial experience
rationale: Explicit two-year experience requirement rules Marc out at this stage.
Discipline is awnings/decks/light structural estimating and drafting, only loosely related to Marc's civil coursework.
St Marys, Sydney NSW, an acceptable but non-VIC location, secondary to the experience gap.
caution: Rough fit, not an interview forecast; the two-year experience line is explicit, not an unknown.
